question: The Sangeet Natak Akademi of India recognises 8 dance forms of Indian classical dance. Which of the following is NOT included?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chhau__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are **eight** main** classical dance forms** in India:

 
 
• **Bharatanatyam **- Tamil Nadu
 
• **Kathak **- Uttar Pradesh
 
• **Odissi **- Odisha
 
• **Manipuri **- Manipur
 
• **Kuchipudi** - Andhra Prades
